name: 34284-tightslots-30ba3b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, bf16 unquantized -- not the FP8 sibling, whose block_n 128 does not divide the 96-wide per-rank MoE at TP8. Present in the local HF cache; nothing downloads at run time.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, EP off, PP=1, DP=1, no DP attention. Overlap scheduling left at its default (on).
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30B total / ~3B active, 48 layers, GQA 32 query : 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 128 routed experts at top-8; the rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 4000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix. 256 prompt tokens, fixed. Out: 900 tokens with stdev 58, floored at 800 and capped at 1000.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 30B mixture-of-experts model, serving 256 concurrent users short prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Eight GPUs of one node, an unquantized bf16 MoE at TP8, with the
# admission ceiling set to exactly the offered load of 256 closed-loop streams.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507
tp-size: 8

# Written out rather than left to the engine, which would otherwise derive it from the KV pool
# and the model's 262144-token context.
max-running-requests: 256

# 16384 is the largest value that leaves a workable static fraction: the engine reserves ~1.5 MB of
# activation memory per prefill token, so 32768 would reserve 48 GB of an 80 GB card.
chunked-prefill-size: 16384
max-prefill-tokens: 16384

# The engine's own derived value for the chunk size above, written out so a device-memory probe
# cannot resize the KV pool.
mem-fraction-static: 0.66

# Every other `--prefill-delayer-*` knob is left at its default and no SGLANG_* variable is set.
# Do NOT add `--disable-overlap-schedule`: with the delayer enabled the server will not start.
enable-prefill-delayer: true
